name: Imouto Moe
source:
This is a visual novel that tells the story of a girl Moe who lives together with her brother.

The protagonist's parents are gone on a trip, so now he's living together with his sister. Up until recently, his sister, who is almost the same age, had been living elsewhere.
The siblings are at an age where they start to become interested in sex, and now that they are together they become sexually aware of each other. Then the brother gives in to his desire and assaults his sister.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ041105.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一部视觉小说，讲述了女孩莫伊和她哥哥住在一起的故事。

主角的父母出差了，现在和妹妹住在一起。直到最近，与他年龄相仿的妹妹一直住在别处。
兄弟姐妹正到了开始对性产生兴趣的年龄，现在他们在一起了，他们对彼此有了性意识。然后弟弟屈服于自己的欲望并攻击了他的妹妹。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ041105.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
